tagline: A leading global independent crude oil and natural gas exploration, development and production company
hero_kpi_rationale: 52.8% operating margin reflecting strong management discipline and robust earnings generation in the energy sector, supported by controlled costs and an optimized operational structure.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: The percentage of revenue that becomes profit before taxes and other expenses.
kpis.description: The 52.8% operating margin demonstrates strong earnings generation driven by operational efficiency and an optimized cost structure.
kpis.signal: Very high operating margin, indicating excellent management discipline.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: The portion of revenue that remains after paying direct production costs.
kpis.description: The 70.2% gross margin reflects solid performance, supported by controlled production costs and favorable oil prices.
kpis.signal: High gross margin, typical of the energy sector with strong operational profitability.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Money spent to build or acquire productive facilities such as wells or refineries.
kpis.description: Capex of $5.8 billion in 2025, slightly higher, aimed at sustaining and expanding production.
kpis.signal: Moderately increasing capex, aligned with a disciplined organic growth strategy.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of people employed by the company.
kpis.description: 8,200 employees in 2025, a stable workforce reflecting a growth strategy without over-expansion.
kpis.signal: Stable headcount despite sector pressures, indicating organizational stability.

ai_positioning.summary: CNQ mentions the use of AI in internal controls and risk management, but without operational details or a dedicated strategy. AI is presented as a tool for compliance and cybersecurity, not as a growth or innovation driver.
evidence: The audit committee reviews risks related to AI use.
AI is included in financial control and cybersecurity policies.
No AI projects or AI-related revenue are mentioned.
